settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Settings is divided into sections — Project (metadata, goals, statuses, deadlines), Appearance (themes, fonts, colours, density), General (data location & connection), and Backups (autosave, full backup / restore, and workspace reset). AI providers, routing, usage, and writing-AI settings live in the AI menu. Nothing here touches your manuscript prose.

language.label: Language
language.hint: User-interface language. Date and number formatting follow the same locale.

server.headlessHint: Run the server on its own and open the app in any browser — no desktop install needed. The server hosts the UI at:
server.authHint: Off by default. Add a token to require an Authorization: Bearer header on every /v1 API call — for when you run the server exposed beyond this machine.
server.requireLoopback: Require a token even on localhost
server.noTokens: No tokens — the API is open (fine for local-only use).

appearance.functionalColoursHint: Success, danger and info — used by status chips, banners and the buttons and tags below. Like the accent, you pick a hue and every shade stays legible in light & dark.
appearance.buttonIntentsHint: Each button has a single intent that encodes both colour and visual style. Primary (solid accent) is the main affordance. Secondary is outlined neutral for supporting actions. Ghost is quiet text-only for utility. Danger / Success / Info follow the functional colours above, Accent 2 follows your second accent — all solid fills for clear status. Re-tinting any colour above re-skins them all.
appearance.backgroundsHint: Tint each area independently — every option is tuned to stay legible. Pick a curated swatch or click Custom for any colour. The Text row picks the text-colour family used across the app.
appearance.inlinePaperLabel: Apply editor paper to inline fields
appearance.inlinePaperHint: Character, note & worldbuilding rich-text fields pick up the paper tint instead of the surface.
appearance.editorLayoutHint: How the manuscript editor presents your prose while you write.
appearance.editorLayoutPageHint: Centered sheet with margins and running head.
appearance.editorLayoutOverrideNote: Per-document overrides for any of these live in the editor's ⚙ Writing settings — pick theme there to fall back to the theme default.
appearance.editorWritingHint: Defaults for the manuscript prose — font size, line spacing, paragraph spacing, and first-line indent. Per-document choices in the editor's ⚙ Writing settings override these.
appearance.buttonStylingHint: Shape, padding, and label casing for every button across the app.
appearance.resetTooltip: Reset every appearance setting to the default look
appearance.presetsHint: Start from a curated look, then fine-tune anything below.
appearance.savePresetCurrentHint: Keep this mix as a preset
appearance.deletePresetMessage: Removes this custom preset. Your current appearance stays as it is.
appearance.resetMessage: Returns every appearance setting — including light/dark mode — to the default look. Your saved custom presets are kept.

appearance.previewProse2: Above her, the deck complained in its joints — and the fog, she now understood, was not weather.

appearance.menuItemHint: Each sidebar entry — Home, Chapters, Characters, and so on.
appearance.accentsHint: Accent drives selection, the active nav item, buttons and links. Accent 2 is the secondary — rings, rules, peak markers, and the accent2 intent on buttons and tags.

backups.deleteSelectedMessage: The selected on-disk autosave files are permanently removed. This can't be undone.
backups.deleteAllMessage: Every on-disk autosave file is permanently removed. This can't be undone.
backups.restoreMessage: Saved at {when}. Your current workspace will be overwritten — every project, chapter body, and AI provider. Export a backup first if you want to keep what you have.
backups.autosavePending: Pending — will fire within 10s of the next edit.
backups.autosaveHint: Every edit is also mirrored to a JSON file on disk within ~10s. Two prior generations are kept (.prev.json / .prev2.json) so a bad write or accidental reset can be recovered without a manual export. Each file is a full workspace bundle — project, AI providers, sessions — so restoring one file brings everything back. By default it lives inside your data folder (shown below); anything OneDrive / Time Machine / your backup tool watches in this folder will pick it up automatically.
backups.emptyList: No autosaves on disk yet. They start appearing after the first edit.
backups.thisBookHint: Export the current book as a single .zip — its text, structure, and images — to move it to another computer or share it, then Import a .zip back as a new book. Each chooser remembers where you last saved.

OpenAI-compatible covers OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM — anything that exposes /v1/chat/completions. providerForm.tooltipFetchModels: Query GET /v1/models on the Base URL above
providerForm.fieldTierTitle: Attribution pipeline capability bucket for this model. Auto-picked by name pattern; you can pin a different choice if you know better. Guided = scaffolded examples for sub-12B models. Direct = strict rules for 12B-class non-reasoning. Reasoned = strict rules + implicit reasoning for hybrid models (Qwen3:14B+).
providerForm.fieldEmbeddingModelTitle: Optional embedding model — fills the RAG (manuscript chat) index. Leave blank if this provider isn't your embedding provider. OpenAI: text-embedding-3-small. Ollama: nomic-embed-text. Anthropic / Google / OpenRouter generally don't expose embedding endpoints — leave blank.

ai.triggerTooltip: AI writing assist — Rewrite, Expand, Tighten, Continue, Line edits
ai.unstuckNeedsProse: Write a few lines first — Unstuck needs prose to brainstorm from.
ai.highlightSubjectFirst: Highlight a subject first (a place, object, or moment).
ai.rewriteDesc: Rewrite the passage to be more vivid and specific while preserving meaning, tense, and voice. Selection-only because a whole-scene rewrite is too transformative for one click — use the Routing-by-task Lab for that.
ai.expandDesc: Add sensory detail, interiority, and small actions. Roughly doubles the length without changing voice or tense.
ai.describeDesc: Treat the highlighted text as a subject — a place, person, object, or moment — and add 1–2 paragraphs of fresh sensory prose ABOUT it right after. Additive, not a rewrite; the original passage stays untouched.
ai.sensoryDesc: Sibling to Describe. Instead of streamed prose, get a structured pack of short sensory phrases (smell, sound, touch, temperature, taste, movement, social, period detail). Pick the ones that fit and click to drop them into your manuscript.
ai.tightenDesc: Remove filler words, hedges, and redundant phrases. Keeps the meaning, voice, and tense intact — the result is noticeably shorter. Runs on the selection, or the whole scene if nothing is selected.
ai.continueDesc: Write 2–4 more paragraphs from where the cursor is, matching the voice, tense, and POV of what came before.
ai.guidedDesc: Same as Continue, but you give it a one-line instruction first ("Elena confronts Marcus but he deflects with charm"). The next 2–4 paragraphs honour your direction while matching the voice, tense, and POV of what came before.
ai.unstuckDesc: When you're not sure what should happen next, ask the model for five distinct moves (goal shift, interrupt, setting change, reveal, time cut). Pick one and JustWrite drafts the next 2–4 paragraphs in that direction.
ai.lineEditsHint: Selection, or whole scene if none
ai.clearStrikesDesc: Remove every struck-through original left behind by accepted AI changes (and the originals of still-pending ones — that accepts them). The new text stays.
